purpose: PETReviewCompare is a 3D Slicer extension providing advanced SPECT/PET and CT/MRI review capabilities, fusion, MIP, reading layouts, windowing presets, SUV measurements with spherical ROIs, and optional AI post-processing filters.
summary: PETReviewCompare is a well-structured and cleanly implemented 3D Slicer extension for nuclear medicine (SPECT/PET and CT/MRI review). All codebase guidelines are respected: PyTorch is correctly handled via PyTorchUtils, additional package installations require explicit user confirmation, licensing and packaging are correct, and code architecture is robust. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: No unauthorized telemetry, external connections, hardcoded secrets, or unsafe deserialization routines found; torch.load uses weights_only where supported.

environment.rationale: Packages such as monai and einops are installed via slicer.util.pip_install only after explicit user confirmation through a modal dialog, and PyTorch installation is correctly deferred to PyTorchUtils.

packaging.rationale: All python scripts, icons, UI files, and color maps are properly declared in CMakeLists.txt and built into scripted modules.

license.rationale: Includes an explicit MIT License with correct copyright notices.

soundness.rationale: Well-structured ScriptedLoadableModule design with observer cleanup, proper use of slicer conventions, and robust helper functions with unit tests.

utility.rationale: Extensive documentation, clean modular layout (EponaLib), unit tests, and helpful user features for nuclear medicine review.

not_checked: Full interactive runtime testing of GUI functionality in Slicer (due to absence of local Slicer environment).
